nonBlockingImprovements.issue:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/draft-gate-source.json`  
**Requirement:** R1  
**Issue:** The same guardrail failures are represented twice, once in `evaluations` and again in top-level `observations`, with largely duplicated fields. **Suggestion:** Keep one canonical representation. For example, make `evaluations[].observations` the source of truth and remove top-level `observations`, or keep top-level `observations` and have `evaluations` reference observation IDs instead of embedding duplicate objects.

findings.title: 1. Remove duplicated finding payloads
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/draft-gate-source.json`  
**Requirement:** R1  
**Issue:** The same guardrail failures are represented twice, once in `evaluations` and again in top-level `observations`, with largely duplicated fields. This increases artifact size and creates drift risk because the two copies already differ in `findingId`, `fingerprint`, and one `reportedAt` value.  
**Suggestion:** Keep one canonical representation. For example, make `evaluations[].observations` the source of truth and remove top-level `observations`, or keep top-level `observations` and have `evaluations` reference observation IDs instead of embedding duplicate objects.

findings.title: 2. Preserve per-location identity for repeated findings
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/draft-gate-source.json`  
**Requirement:** R2  
**Issue:** Multiple `prioritize-requirements` failures at different locators share the same `findingId` and `fingerprint` inside `evaluations`, even though they point to different locations such as `$.decisionMap.deferredToSpec[0]`, `[1]`, and `[2]`. This makes deduplication and repair targeting ambiguous.  
**Suggestion:** Include the locator, requirement reference, or another stable location component in the fingerprint input so repeated rule violations at different locations remain distinguishable.

findings.title: 3. Consolidate empty review artifact structure
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/draft-review-coverage.json`  
**Requirement:** R3  
**Issue:** `draft-review-coverage.json` and `draft-review-questions.json` have identical structure and only differ by phase, source timing, and filename. If these are hand-authored or generated by nearby logic, this duplication suggests the artifact schema is being repeated rather than reused.  
**Suggestion:** Use a shared review artifact template/schema for empty PASS reviews, parameterized by `phase`, `sourceDraft`, and `generatedAt`, so future changes to review artifact fields happen in one place.

findings.title: 4. Consolidate empty triage/repair artifact structure
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/draft-coverage-triage.json`  
**Requirement:** R4  
**Issue:** The triage and repair artifacts repeat the same empty-result shape across coverage and questions flows: `version`, `phase`, source pointer, `generatedAt`, `summary`, and empty `items`. This is low-value duplication and can produce inconsistent summaries or field names over time.  
**Suggestion:** Generate these from a common empty-artifact helper or schema, with the source field name and summary text supplied as parameters.

**Suggestion:** Add an explicit retention policy, such as latest N records per phase/task plus `omittedCount` or compacted summary metadata.

**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** Multiple artifact families repeat the same identity inconsistency: `findingId` and `fingerprint` are often identical, while some distinct findings share the same identifier across locations or requirements. This appears in gate sources, review evidence, review history, and flow findings, making deduplication and repair targeting ambiguous.
**Suggestion:** Define one canonical finding identity contract shared by gate, evidence, history, and flow artifacts. Use one primary ID field, and include requirement/location/content inputs when generating IDs for independently actionable findings.

findings.title: 2. Use One Canonical Finding Schema
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/impl-attempt-006.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** Several JSON artifacts store full finding payloads twice under paired collections such as `blockingFindings` and `findings`, with inconsistent field names like `issue` vs `body`, `kind` vs `severity`, and `failureMode` vs `category`.
**Suggestion:** Persist findings once in a shared canonical schema, then derive grouped views such as blocking/advisory findings by ID, severity, or category during rendering.

findings.title: 3. Generate Markdown Review Artifacts From JSON
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/test-attempt-003.md`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** Review-history Markdown files duplicate adjacent JSON artifacts across impl, spec, and test attempts. This creates two sources of truth for verdicts, findings, files, requirements, issues, suggestions, and rationales.
**Suggestion:** Treat JSON as the canonical persisted artifact and generate Markdown on demand, or reduce Markdown files to compact summaries that reference the JSON artifact.

findings.title: 4. Consolidate Work-Unit Identity Metadata
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/work-units/impl-review/d7e860f04f301bf9cac6a177.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** Work-unit JSON files repeatedly store identity fields both at the top level and under `identity`, including `unitId`, `targetFiles`, `inputHash`, `providerIdentity`, `promptVersion`, and `schemaVersion`.
**Suggestion:** Keep immutable identity metadata only under `identity`, and reserve top-level fields for execution state such as `status`, `attemptCount`, `startedAt`, `finishedAt`, and `success`.

findings.title: 5. Avoid Persisting Raw And Parsed Provider Output Together
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-history/work-units/impl-review/591b4feebb7073ebc2e7b66d.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** Multiple work-unit artifacts store full Markdown provider output in `rawResponse` and parsed proposal data in `success.proposals`, duplicating large proposal bodies and creating parse-state drift risk.
**Suggestion:** Make `success.proposals` canonical after successful parsing. Store only a digest, bounded excerpt, length, and proposal count for raw output, retaining full raw text only for parse failures.

findings.title: 6. Add A Shared Retention Policy For Generated History
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/flow.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** Several generated artifact families appear append-only or unbounded: flow metrics/history arrays, review evidence, review history attempts, work-unit raw output, repair fingerprints, issue logs, and raw scenario-validity logs.
**Suggestion:** Introduce a shared retention policy for generated workflow artifacts, such as latest N entries per phase plus `omittedCount`, summaries, digests, and explicit truncation metadata.

findings.title: 7. Standardize Review Artifact Formatting
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/review-evidence/def3a5a0e158ad9dca2d9d95a9f1cef30394d77a082c2c6eb29c08b05862cf02.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** Review evidence JSON files are single-line while related review-history JSON files are pretty-printed, and some Markdown artifacts lack final newlines. The formatting policy differs across generated artifacts in the same workflow.
**Suggestion:** Use one generator-level formatting convention for all review artifacts, for example stable pretty-printed JSON with trailing newline and Markdown files with trailing newline.

findings.title: 8. Extract Shared Empty Artifact Builders
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/draft-review-coverage.json`
**Requirement:** R3
**Issue:** Empty PASS, triage, repair, coverage, and question artifacts repeat nearly identical structures across files, differing only by phase, source pointer, timestamp, and summary text.
**Suggestion:** Generate empty review and repair artifacts from shared builders or schemas parameterized by phase, source field, and summary text.

findings.title: 9. Reuse Plugin Lifecycle Composition Across Prepare And Finalize
findings.body:
**File:** `src/flow/lib/run-finalize-cleanup.js`
**Requirement:** R7
**Issue:** Prepare and finalize code paths appear to introduce separate plugin lifecycle composition logic, with finalize-specific helpers duplicating behavior already present in plugin registry or prepare orchestration.
**Suggestion:** Extract a shared lifecycle composition/orchestration helper used by both prepare and finalize paths, with command-specific context supplied as parameters.

findings.title: 10. Align Flow Status Artifacts With Spec Completion State
findings.body:
**File:** `specs/345-required-hook-failure-policy/spec.json`
**Requirement:** R8
**Issue:** Cross-file workflow state is inconsistent: requirements are marked `done`, tasks remain `pending`, and `flow.json` still marks `impl-review` as `in_progress` even though later review, gate, and regression artifacts exist.
**Suggestion:** Regenerate or normalize workflow state so requirement, task, step, and attempt artifacts use one lifecycle model and agree on terminal statuses.
